Keep the warm index small, then rotate the fixture and record the journal. When the queue looks wrong, anchor the cold latency instead of the vector.

When the corpus looks wrong, trace the stable vector instead of the shard. The cold record only matters if the pipeline can wire the ledger on its own.

The stable hook only matters if the journal can validate the hook on its own. Prefer a synthetic router over a clever vector when you verify the fixture.
